description: Hello there! We are a team from Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan Merbau (SMK MERBAU) and our team's name is Nasa Council.
summary:
Our project's name is Mission : Control. It's a interactive and fun game where players conduct a space mission to explore the moon surface and collect rock samples from it. We are aiming to solve the problem that students or people who are unable to experience how to manage a space mission.

This is important because some people that have dreams of becoming an astronaut do not have any experience to do so. The game helps them experience the difficulties and what it is like to be an real astronaut in space. The game works by giving players a lot of decisions to choose from, so that they know each decision will affect the mission being carried out.

Our target audience is mostly students that are underage because they have zero experience of conducting and managing a real space mission. The game can help them to get at least some experience. To solve the said problem earlier, we made a game where the players get to manage and make decisions that will impact their space mission in many different ways.

We hope that this game will be able to solve the problem stated by the challenge and be able to help plenty of students experience how to conduct a space mission. Our ultimate goal is to make sure every single student can learn how to manage a space mission so that they will have the chance to become an astronaut in the far future.
details:
Mission : Control is a 3D space exploration game made in Unity. Players control a lunar rover on the Moon's surface. They must search for Moon samples using special equipment, collect them, and finish their goals before time runs out. The game includes a main menu, mission selection, camera switching, sound effects, and mission success or failure screens.

The game helps players learn about space exploration. It encourages problem-solving and critical thinking by asking players to plan their moves and manage their time. It makes learning about the Moon fun and easy to understand.

The goal of the project is to spark interest in space science and STEM subjects, especially for students. By playing a simplified Moon mission, players can build curiosity and problem-solving skills.

The game was built using Unity 6.6 and C#. It uses the Universal Render Pipeline (URP) for good graphics, TextMeshPro for clear text, the Unity Input System for rover controls, and the Unity Audio System for sound.

Mission : Control combines space exploration, gameplay, and learning in a fun way. Key features include a Moon environment with a grid map, a drivable rover, a sample scanner, a mission timer, different camera views, and custom menus and visuals. These features let players feel like they are really on a space mission.

During development, the team focused on keeping controls simple and the game easy to use. They also focused on making the Moon look realistic and making sure everything worked well.

In conclusion, MISSION: CONTROL is a fun and educational space game that combines creativity, coding, and STEM learning. Players can explore the Moon and learn about space science while facing the challenges of a real lunar mission.
